title: Bounded-below complexes admit bounded-below injective replacements
statement: Let $\mathcal A$ be an abelian category [def-sp-abelian] with enough injectives [def-sp-injective-resolutions], and let $K^\bullet$ be a bounded-below cochain complex of $\mathcal A$-objects [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Then there are a bounded-below cochain complex $I^\bullet$ whose terms are injective objects of $\mathcal A$ and a quasi-isomorphism $K^\bullet\to I^\bullet$ [def-weil-pbc-kinjective-resolutions].
